title: Tracked changes xlsx 001
notes: openpyxl has no revisions API, so the xlsx change-tracking layer (§18.16.8 worksheetRevisions, ECMA-376 part 1) is injected post-save by a zip rewrite: a minimal <worksheetRevisions> block with 2 <revision> records (revisionType deleteCell + insertCell, authorId=0, date 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, r:id 1/2) appended before </worksheet> in sheet1.xml, with the r namespace declared on the injected element (openpyxl's sheet root omits xmlns:r). Synthetic revision records, NOT Excel-authored history: there is no author table and no workbook-level revision history (xl/revisions/*.xml, CT_Workbook/revision §18.2.11), so authorId 0 is dangling and the cell grid holds only the current-state values; LO/Excel tolerance of this minimal shape varies. Reference text = the surviving cell values only.
